newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Sept 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Sept 13.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Friday:

* Republican presidential nominee Bob Dole, who resigned from the Senate three months ago, wrote a letter to Senate majority leader Trent Lott in an effort to influence the Senate's handling of the chemical weapons treaty and the immigration bill.
* The Clinton Administration agreed to help evacuate more than 2,000 Iraqi refugees caught in the Kurdish conflict.
* The United States is seeing a surge in immigrant naturalization.
* Over 25 percent of new school teachers begin the job with inadequate skills and training, according to a study.
* Gillette Co agreed to acquire Duracell International Inc for about $7 billion in stock.
* Archeologists found the remnants of James Fort, the site of the first successful English settlement in the United States, which was built in what is now the state of Virginia in 1607.
